description.value: MOD Pizza is a fast-casual pizza chain where customers build their own individual pizza or salad from over 40 fresh ingredients and eight finishing sauces, cooked in a high-temperature gas-fired oven in minutes. This Country Club Centre location is MOD's second-ever Canadian outpost, opened in 2022 inside a large shopping centre conveniently near a Save-On-Foods grocery store. Touring cyclists will find a quick, filling, fully customizable meal available for carryout.
